qa: Yes. You must activate this card’s inherited effect and use up its [Once Per Turn], even if the attacking Digimon doesn't have [Greymon] or [Omnimon] in its name. However, if the attacking Digimon doesn't have [Greymon] or [Omnimon] in its name, you can't reference DP or delete a Digimon.

text_sections.text: [Digivolve] Lv.5 w/[Greymon] in name or w/[ADVENTURE]/[Hero] trait: Cost 3

text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: ＜Raid＞ ＜Piercing＞ [On Play] [When Digivolving] Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with as much or less DP as this Digimon. [All Turns] This Digimon gets +1000 DP for each of your Tamers' colors, and gains ＜Security A. +1＞ for every 3 such colors. [End of Your Turn] 1 of your Digimon may attack.

text_sections.label: Inherited Effect
text_sections.text: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with as much or less DP as this Digimon with [Greymon] or [Omnimon] in its name.
